scope: Local near-resonance detection audit; standard tests and information bounds, not a new detector
physical_units: stiffness, thermal energy and original sampling interval are one
design_rule: Choose a single lag maximizing scalar Gaussian Fisher information for alias around null_alias using known null and noise only; no alternative labels or simulated outcomes used in design
oracle_rule: True alternative/null-1 log likelihood ratio, threshold calibrated on independent null data by order statistic k=ceil((M+1)*(1-alpha)); a numerical approximation to the Neyman-Pearson oracle, not a deployable alternative-blind test
practical_rule: Reuse equal-split Gaussian likelihood family rejection and chi-square concentration family rejection at alpha; listed null family remains aliases 1,2,3
information_bound: Total variation <= sqrt(min(KL(Palt||Pnull),KL(Pnull||Palt))/2); power <= min(1,alpha+this value), for level-alpha tests at null 1
sampling: Independent equilibrium Gaussian position pairs with independent sensor noise; exact Wishart sufficient statistics for each half. Equal total pair budgets across schedules.
uncertainty: Independent evaluation null and alternative data; Wilson 95 percent Monte Carlo intervals per cell, conditional on calibrated threshold. Calibration uncertainty separate; no simultaneous claims.
fairness: Oracle knows the exact alternative and need only control null 1. Practical tests control all three listed nulls. Oracle comparison is an information-rich reference, not matched training information.
holdout: No reuse of alias 1.05 or prior noise 0.2. No threshold or lag tuning after evaluation outcomes.
